digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: Tech, AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, Design

stories.headline: Anthropic Launches Record IPO Roadshow
stories.blurb: Anthropic initiated its public offering roadshow aiming for a valuation up to $1.4 trillion, marking a landmark moment for commercial foundational AI labs.

stories.headline: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2
stories.blurb: Anthropic launched its updated Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models, delivering 30% faster output generation alongside enhanced reasoning, coding, and vision capabilities.

stories.headline: Meta Introduces Lightweight Muse Ember Model
stories.blurb: Meta released Muse Ember, a compact reasoning model engineered for high-efficiency agentic tasks like tool calling, coding, and document parsing at reduced cost.

stories.headline: Google Unveils TPU 8i Max and Secure 8tx Silicon
stories.blurb: Google expanded its custom AI hardware lineup with the high-memory TPU 8i Max for massive context windows and the 8tx for hardware-encrypted, confidential inference.

stories.headline: Attackers Abuse Qubole AWS Cross-Account Access
stories.blurb: Threat actors actively exploited lingering cross-account IAM trust roles to harvest secrets and exfiltrate S3 bucket contents across customer cloud environments.

stories.headline: SonicWall Warns of Exploited SSL-VPN MFA Bypass
stories.blurb: SonicWall issued urgent patches for an actively exploited vulnerability in SonicOS SSL-VPN appliances that allows authenticated users to bypass multi-factor authentication controls.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind Uses Gemini to Formally Verify Signal Protocol
stories.blurb: Researchers leveraged Google's Gemini model to formally verify the core Signal cryptographic protocol, advancing automated mathematical proof for security-critical software.

stories.headline: PHP2Shell Zero-Day Enables Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
stories.blurb: Security researchers published a deep dive into PHP2Shell, a critical heap memory corruption vulnerability in PHP 8.4 that allows attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.

stories.headline: PyTorch Brings In-Browser GPU Acceleration via ExecuTorch
stories.blurb: Meta's PyTorch team introduced ExecuTorch WebGPU, allowing developers to execute production AI models directly inside web browsers using client GPU hardware.

stories.headline: Meta Open-Sources Hardware-Native TLX GPU Compiler
stories.blurb: Meta open-sourced TLX, a specialized GPU compiler designed to optimize memory bandwidth and execution efficiency for large-scale production machine learning workloads.

stories.headline: Broadcom Donates VM API Project to CNCF Sandbox
stories.blurb: Broadcom contributed its VM API project to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation to provide a standardized, Kubernetes-native approach to managing virtual machines.

stories.headline: Microsoft Outlook Authentication Changes Bounce Legitimate Mail
stories.blurb: Microsoft's stricter enforcement of SPF and DMARC rules on Outlook.com resulted in widespread delivery failures and false-positive bounces for compliant enterprise senders.

stories.headline: GitHub Unveils Redesigned Pull Request Overview
stories.blurb: GitHub rolled out an opt-in preview for its pull request page, featuring a compact summary header that highlights merge readiness, active blockers, and required actions.

stories.headline: Design Engineers Shift from Static Figma to Production Code
stories.blurb: Product teams are shortening development cycles as design engineers replace static Figma handoffs with interactive, functional prototypes built directly in application codebases.
